name: Snipes Farm, Nursery and Golf
description: In Morrisville, PA, Snipes Farm, Nursery and Golf raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
